question.:question/problem: What is the minimum value of $f(x)=4\sin(4x-1)+2$?
question.:question/worked-solution:
The range of $\sin x$ is

$$
-1\le \sin x\le 1.
$$

Horizontal shifts and stretches have no effect on the range. Therefore,

$$
-1\le \sin(4x-1)\le 1.
$$

Multiplying the above inequality by $4$ and then adding $2$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned} & -1\le \sin(4x-1)\le 1 \\  & -4\le 4\sin(4x-1)\le 4 \\  & -2\le 4\sin(4x-1)+2\le 6 \\  & -2\le f(x)\le 6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the minimum value is $-2.$

question.:question/problem: What is the range of the function $y=3\sin(4x+\frac{\pi}{4})-5$?
question.:question/worked-solution:

$$
-1\le \sin x\le 1.

Multiplying the above inequality by $3$ and then subtracting $5$, we get
